entities.title: Payload
entities.summary: The native string a GString carries, by pointer, with what it points to (its carrier), what its bytes mean (its encoding) and who frees it (its ownership). GPayload.
notToBeConfusedWith: Body: what GStrings share, which points at a payload

entities.title: Body
entities.summary: What GStrings share, copy-on-write: a reference count, the generation, the cached length and hashes, and the payload. GBody.
notToBeConfusedWith: Payload: bodies can share one payload, as conversion and comparison leave them

entities.title: Carrier
entities.summary: What a payload's pointer points to: a char*, a wchar_t*, a BSTR, a foreign string object held by value, a string list, a slice of another payload, or nothing. GCarrier::Type.

entities.title: Literal
entities.summary: A payload compiled into the binary's read-only data, which GString borrows for free, never frees, and keeps when two equal strings are made to share one payload. GString::Literal, GOwnership::Literal.
notToBeConfusedWith: Borrowed: also never freed, but never handed on and never the survivor

entities.title: Borrowed
entities.summary: A payload the caller promised outlives every GString that shares it. GString never frees it and never hands it on. GString::Borrow, GOwnership::Borrowed.
notToBeConfusedWith: A GSubString, which borrows another GString's storage by holding a reference to its body

entities.title: Survivor
entities.summary: The payload kept when a comparison finds two GStrings with different payloads equal; both bodies then point at it. GSurvivor.

entities.title: Generation
entities.summary: A counter in the body that goes up whenever its payload is replaced, so that a GSpot walking the old payload knows to find its place again by character index.

entities.title: Character
entities.summary: A Unicode code point. Every length names its unit: bytes, code units or characters.
notToBeConfusedWith: Code unit: one byte of UTF-8, or two bytes of UTF-16
Extended grapheme cluster: what a reader sees as one character, defined in 2008, after GString

entities.title: String list
entities.summary: The pieces of a GString made with +, kept unjoined as its payload until something needs the characters in one piece. GStringList, GCarrier::StringList.

entities.title: Slice
entities.summary: The payload of a GString made from a GSubString: an offset into another payload, which keeps the original alive. GCarrier::Slice.
notToBeConfusedWith: GSubString::Detach, which copies just the piece's characters and lets the original go
